product.name: EAI Setup
product.description: A signed desktop setup experience for the EAI developer workflow.
product.accessControl: EAI login and tenant policy control platform access

installers.linux: sudo apt-get install -y git or sudo dnf install -y git
Use the distribution package manager and verify Node.js 20 or newer

workflow: install missing Git and Node.js prerequisites using a fixed platform adapter
install or update the EAI CLI from npm
select or confirm the company tenant
choose an existing folder or create a new project folder
run eai init so Gofer assets and the app template are fetched by the supported CLI
verify the generated project and show the next AI/editor action

runtime.secrets: No token, password, client secret, or tenant secret is bundled in the installer.
runtime.deviceIdentity: A random local device identifier may be stored for future activation; it is not hardware fingerprinting and is not transmitted by this repository.
runtime.aiHosts: The installer does not silently install or authenticate commercial AI applications. It detects documented editor integrations and lets the user choose one.
